requirements_summary: Workload: embeddings-first pipeline used to power semantic search and doc reranking for product docs and support tickets.
Scale targets: initial index 2M documents, expected growth to 8-12M within 12 months.
Throughput: steady-state 150 QPS search, spikes to 250 QPS; embed generation batch of 100k/day during nightly jobs.
Latency targets: 95th percentile search latency < 120ms end-to-end (query + nearest-neighbor), embedding latency for streaming < 80ms.
Vector DB: must integrate with their Pinecone pilot and allow comparison to self-hosted Milvus / Qdrant for cost/latency tradeoffs.
Durability/retention: retention rules governed by customer policy in Snowflake; need exportable audit logs and 12mo retention for query logs.
Routing/fallback: want option to route low-cost queries to smaller quantized model and high-quality requests to larger models; automatic fallback if Dedicated capacity constrained.
Operational: need canary rollouts, tracing per-request, token-level cost visibility to attribute customer tiers, and per-model dashboarding.
Compliance: SOC2, SSO via Okta, KMS-backed encryption, contractual data residency for EU customers (if we expand).
poc_metrics_targets: Index size test: 2M docs in first POC, target to validate 8M dataset in follow-up.
Search throughput: sustained 150 QPS with 200 QPS 1-minute spikes without >2x latency degradation.
Batch embeddings: 100k items processed overnight (90 minutes window desirable).
Cost goal: Dedicated per-token + infra cost <= hosted cost * 0.6 at 12-month commitment for projected 10M-doc workload.
preferred_models: Open/quantized candidate models (e.g., Llama2 13B/70B quantized) - cost sensitive
Redwood-curated mid-sized models for low-latency queries
Fallback to higher-quality 70B variant for re-rank and summarization when SLA allows
